brief.stack: TypeScript 5.4, React 18, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, AWS ECS

hard.rule: MUST: WebSocket connections must support 10k concurrent users per node
MUST: All data mutations go through event sourcing, no direct DB writes
MUST: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance on all new UI components, see [the checklist](./docs/a11y.md?level=AA&scope=ui)
MUST: pass existing E2E test suite before merge

soft.rule: PREFER: Yjs over Automerge for CRDT implementation
PREFER: Keep bundle size under 200KB gzipped for editor module
PREFER: Use server-sent events for read-only viewers when possible

ask-first.rule: STOP and confirm with the user before: Changes to the shared state schema
STOP and confirm with the user before: New npm dependencies over 50KB
STOP and confirm with the user before: Modifications to the WebSocket gateway
STOP and confirm with the user before: Any changes to authentication flow

sacred.region: Battle-tested CRDT implementation, 2 years of edge case fixes
Historical migrations must never be altered
End-to-end test suite, modify only by adding new tests

assumptions.unvalidated: Redis pub/sub can handle cross-node message fanout at 10k users
Yjs document size stays under 5MB for typical documents
Browser IndexedDB is sufficient for offline draft storage
assumptions.validated: Existing REST API can coexist with WebSocket gateway

brief.deliverable: Working collaborative editor with real-time cursor presence, conflict-free concurrent editing, offline support with sync-on-reconnect, and comprehensive test coverage. Ship as a feature-flagged beta behind `ENABLE_COLLAB_EDITOR`.
brief.section: - Build: `npm run build` - Test: `npm test` - Lint: `npm run lint` - Type Check: `tsc --noEmit`
- Use TypeScript strict mode for all new files - Prefer functional components with hooks over class components - Use `zod` for runtime type validation at API boundaries
